共建能力，共治规则，共享成长

真实参与形成可追溯贡献记录；角色、建议、评议、合作报酬与云汇生态权益分别说明。

贡献记录与云汇生态权益

云汇生态权益用于记录经确认的真实贡献，并作为生态身份、参与及相关规则的依据；不开放转让或买卖，依法依规且有效入账的记录不因时间流逝自动清零。

误发、重复发放、退款关联调整和确认作弊，通过可追溯调整记录处理，不覆盖原始历史，并提供申诉入口。

Web3.0可验证记账规划

规划通过可验证记录、数字签名及按需链上证明追溯贡献来源、规则版本和历史变更；身份、联系方式、经营数据和凭据不直接公开上链。目前不宣称已全部上链或绝对不可篡改。

合作与报酬

开发报酬、维护报酬、推荐佣金、服务权益和云汇生态权益分别说明；不提供公众认购、固定收益或升值承诺。

活动默认关闭

抖音与X领取活动在权限、验证、去重、隐私、费用和条款完成验收前，不提供领取按钮、倒计时或发放接口。

规则边界

本次官网任务不调整权益总量、分池、门槛或释放规则；规则设计不等于已发放。

告诉我们，你希望解决哪项工作

从一个具体问题、重复流程或业务场景开始，先判断是否适合，再确认方案。

公开规则边界

  • 云汇生态权益总量固定2,000万份；总量不等于已发放数量。
  • 三档贡献池与活动专项池均包含在总量内，不得重复相加；具体分池、门槛、释放系数及创始人同步释放规则不由本次官网任务调整。
  • 推荐佣金按云汇有效规则，以核实后的合格毛利润为依据，不按交易流水或充值金额计算。

en/labs.html.html:
Home/Co-creation Ecosystem

CO-CREATION ECOSYSTEM

Build capabilities, govern rules, share growth

Real participation leaves a traceable contribution record. Roles, proposals, reviews, cooperation and compensation remain distinct.

Roles

Customer

Uses services, proposes needs and provides authorized feedback.

Promoter

Introduces customers with real needs.

Developer

Builds, maintains and improves modules.

Partner

Provides implementation, resources or professional services.

Founding team

Builds the platform and bears long-term operating responsibility.

Contribution records and Yunhui Ecosystem Rights

Yunhui Ecosystem Rights records verified contributions and may support identity and participation under valid rules. It cannot be transferred or traded, and valid records do not disappear merely with time.

Mistakes, duplicates, refund-related changes and confirmed abuse are handled through traceable adjustment records without overwriting the original history. An appeal path is provided.

Web3.0 verifiable accounting plan

The plan uses verifiable records, digital signatures and on-demand proof to trace contribution sources, rule versions and history. Identity, contact, operating data and credentials are not placed publicly on-chain. Full on-chain verification is not yet claimed.

Cooperation and compensation

Development, maintenance, referral commission, service rights and Yunhui Ecosystem Rights are explained separately. No public investment or fixed-return promise is offered.

Activities are closed by default

Douyin and X claim activities have no live claim button, countdown or issuance endpoint until permissions, verification, privacy, cost and terms pass acceptance.

Rule boundary

Detailed total supply, pools, thresholds and release rules are not changed by this website task. Rule design is not evidence of issuance.

Tell us which work you want to improve

Start with one concrete problem, repetitive process or business scenario. We first check fit, then confirm the solution.

Describe my needContact Xuanjun

Published rule boundary

  • Yunhui Ecosystem Rights have a fixed total of 20 million units; the total is not evidence of issuance.
  • The three contribution tiers and activity allocation are contained within the total and must not be added again. Detailed ratios, thresholds, release coefficients and founder-linked release are not changed by this website task.
  • Referral commission follows valid Yunhui rules and is based on verified eligible gross profit, not transaction volume or recharge amount.
  • Yunhui Ecosystem Rights have no purchase, transfer, trading, market-price or public profit-sharing entry. Service subscriptions are a separate product.
Rules and appeals
